class.name: VehicleAudioNodeData
class.brief_description: Authoring data for one waveguide graph node.
class.description: VehicleAudioNodeData names either a junction or a single-guide reflection boundary. A junction with zero [member nonlinearity] is linear; positive values compress outgoing pressure as [code]linear / (1 + nonlinearity * abs(linear))[/code]. Boundary reflection is constrained to -1..1 during topology compilation; BoundaryRadiation output taps may select only this single-guide boundary type.

method.name: set_name
method.description: Sets the unique graph node name.

method.name: set_node_type
method.description: Sets the node type: [constant JUNCTION] or [constant REFLECTION_BOUNDARY].

method.name: get_node_type
method.description: Returns the node type enum value.

method.name: set_nonlinearity
method.description: Sets the non-negative junction pressure-compression coefficient; zero preserves the linear response.

method.name: get_nonlinearity
method.description: Returns the authored junction pressure-compression coefficient.

constant.name: REFLECTION_BOUNDARY
constant.description: Single-guide boundary with an authored reflection coefficient.

members.member: Unique non-empty graph name used by guides, sources, and taps.
Reflection coefficient for a boundary, in the inclusive range -1..1.
Non-negative junction pressure-compression coefficient. Zero is identity; positive values use [code]linear / (1 + nonlinearity * abs(linear))[/code]. Boundary nodes ignore this field.
